general.description: Lot of trafics, in this busy and industrial system of Wolf 359. Your typical relay-station in the Barnard road. Sad, fonctionnal, a little crappy. Comes the regular capsule-hotels, where you can rest for a cheap price and sleep, too.
general.bar: Space truckers, spacers and cosmo-vagrants taking a pause in their travels or waiting to found a place in a transporter.
